authority: Latest GitHub main plus MOTION_DEFECT_BACKLOG.json. This file defines shared HOLD-repair execution for all terminals.
objective: Convert HOLD_VISUAL_INTEGRITY pairs to VERIFIED accurately without cross-terminal collision or premature formal promotion.

coordination.frontTerminal: Claim lowest available MOTION issue number first.
coordination.backTerminal: Claim highest available MOTION issue number first.
coordination.releaseRule: Clear claim only after VERIFIED or a new evidence-backed HOLD diagnosis has been committed.

repairUnit.scope: One actionKey pair = hit + rebound. A phase that looks fixed cannot be promoted if the other phase still fails pair-level integrity.
repairUnit.rediagnosisRule: If local repair passes machine QA but pair still fails human visual QA, stop local retries and rewrite root cause at pair level before moving on.

mandatoryStaticGates: single coherent active arm/hand/stick per active limb
stick continuity from grip to tip
fixed drum composite contact and strike semantics
hit and rebound must both pass as one pair

promotion.onStaticFail: HOLD_VISUAL_INTEGRITY with exact visible reason and next permitted repair scope.
promotion.onRuntimeFail: HOLD with exact runtime reason; do not disguise as static pass.

prohibited: whole-character redraw for a local defect
editing locked head/torso/stool/legs unless explicitly diagnosed as active defect
formal PNG promotion from machine QA alone
overwriting or cancelling another terminal's active claim
currentLearning: RD+SN:R/L: two rebound-local method4 attempts improved rebound but pair still fails because hit has duplicated/disconnected right RD arm/hand. Next repair must address right RD arm/hand/stick consistently across BOTH phases.
RD:R: method4 rebound removes original splice, but hit has duplicated/disconnected right RD arm/hand. Next repair must be pair-level, not rebound-only.
Synthetic runtime timeline seek cannot create arbitrary action keys; use real chart occurrences for authoritative runtime PASS.

SN:L: v2-v7 machine-safe local masking exposed neutral-pose residue plus duplicated source hand/stick. Broad neutral restoration created a rectangular plaid patch. Do not continue rectangular mask patching; next repair must reconstruct one coherent left arm/hand/stick while keeping hit/static base protected.

PASS2 execution: prefer a headless artifact loop (candidate -> QA -> reject/refine or promote) so intermediate image generation is not surfaced to the user. Failed candidates remain evidence only; formal assets are rollback anchors.

parallelExecution.note: These are suggestions only; always re-read latest main and claims immediately before claiming.

executionModel.objective: Keep repair generation/processing and QA in repository/workflow artifacts; do not surface intermediate generated images to the user unless explicitly requested.
loop: if FAIL discard/retain evidence and refine next candidate
if PASS run real-chart runtime QA
promote formal only after all gates
executionModel.iterationPolicy: Prefer multiple bounded candidate iterations inside one claimed work unit. Never promote a failed candidate. Preserve formal PNG for rollback.
executionModel.userUiPolicy: Intermediate image previews are not a required deliverable. Prefer GitHub Actions/artifacts/evidence bundles and report only meaningful batch results.
executionModel.safety: If the only available image-edit path cannot verifiably bind the exact source PNG, do not invoke unbound generation repeatedly. Record the block and move to an independently repairable target.
executionModel.sharing: All terminals must read this executionModel from latest main before repair so FRONT/BACK use the same loop.
